info.title: Gaurav Kumar Yadav — Portfolio API
info.description:
Public API for the developer portfolio of Gaurav Kumar Yadav (ggauravky). Provides an AI-powered chat assistant that answers questions about Gaurav's projects, skills, journey, and services. AI responses are grounded in portfolio knowledge base data.

**Portfolio**: https://ggauravky.vercel.app  
**GitHub**: https://github.com/ggauravky  
**LinkedIn**: https://www.linkedin.com/in/gauravky/

## Discovery Resources
- `GET /llms.txt` — Concise LLM knowledge base (Markdown)
- `GET /llms-full.txt` — Full extended knowledge base (Markdown)
- `GET /sitemap.xml` — Site sitemap
- `GET /.well-known/mcp.json` — MCP server manifest
- `GET /.well-known/security.txt` — Security contact

post.summary: Ask a question to the portfolio AI assistant
post.description:
Send a natural-language question about Gaurav Kumar Yadav's portfolio, projects, skills, journey, or services. The AI assistant is grounded in the portfolio knowledge base and returns a structured response with an answer and optional suggestions.

**Example questions:**
- "What projects has Gaurav built?"
- "What is Gaurav's tech stack?"
- "Tell me about the SmartMess project."
- "What services does Gaurav offer?"
- "Has Gaurav completed any internships?"

example.message: What projects has Gaurav built with React?

get.summary: Retrieve the concise LLM knowledge base
get.description: Returns a Markdown-formatted document suitable for LLMs and AI agents. Contains identity, technical expertise, featured projects, services, blog links, and external profiles of Gaurav Kumar Yadav. Follows the llms.txt specification (https://llmstxt.org).

get.summary: Retrieve the full extended LLM knowledge base
get.description: Returns a comprehensive Markdown document with full project catalog (26 projects), detailed skill matrix, all services, blog articles, journey milestones, and direct navigation index. Preferred for agents that need complete portfolio context.
Returns a standard XML sitemap listing all publicly accessible pages, projects, and blog posts on the portfolio. Auto-generated at build time.
Returns this OpenAPI 3.0 specification document describing all public API endpoints of the portfolio.
Returns the Model Context Protocol (MCP) manifest describing AI capabilities and tools available from this portfolio. Agents can use this to discover how to interact with the portfolio AI assistant.
Downloads the latest PDF resume of Gaurav Kumar Yadav.
